say:1:1422402001:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, it seems we need to trouble you again...
say:1:1422402001:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, it seems we need to trouble you again...
say:1:1422402001:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, it seems we need to trouble you again...

say:2:1422402002:1.text: This matter is a bit difficult to handle, so Imperator Ravion specifically requested for you.
say:2:1422402002:1.source_cn: 这件事有些难处理，所以沙利叶大人才特意找你，并且让我协助。
say:2:1422402002:1.male: This matter is a bit difficult to handle, so Imperator Ravion specifically requested for you.
say:2:1422402002:1.female: This matter is a bit difficult to handle, so Imperator Ravion specifically requested for you.

choice_prompt:3:1422402002.text: This matter is a bit difficult to handle, so Imperator Ravion specifically requested for you.
choice_prompt:3:1422402002.source_cn: 这件事有些难处理，所以沙利叶大人才特意找你，并且让我协助。
choice_prompt:3:1422402002.male: This matter is a bit difficult to handle, so Imperator Ravion specifically requested for you.
choice_prompt:3:1422402002.female: This matter is a bit difficult to handle, so Imperator Ravion specifically requested for you.

say:4:1422402003:1.text: The thing is Priestess Zana has been here ever since Her Majesty... No, ever since the statue of Seralyth collapsed, she's been guarding this spot.
say:4:1422402003:1.source_cn: 事情是这样的，那位是祭司扎娜。自从女王陛下……不，奈萨...
say:4:1422402003:1.male: The thing is Priestess Zana has been here ever since Her Majesty... No, ever since the statue of Seralyth collapsed, she's been guarding this spot.
say:4:1422402003:1.female: The thing is Priestess Zana has been here ever since Her Majesty... No, ever since the statue of Seralyth collapsed, she's been guarding this spot.

say:5:1422402004:1.text: No matter how we tried to dissuade her or drive her off, she won't budge.
say:5:1422402004:1.source_cn: 无论我们劝阻还是驱赶，她都不愿意离开。
say:5:1422402004:1.male: No matter how we tried to dissuade her or drive her off, she won't budge.
say:5:1422402004:1.female: No matter how we tried to dissuade her or drive her off, she won't budge.

say:6:1422402005:0.text: I must guard this place. This statue is more than just a statue.
say:6:1422402005:0.source_cn: 我必须在此守护，这座雕像……不仅仅是一座雕像。

say:7:1422402006:1.text: Apparently, there's trouble... Zana, tell it yourself.
say:7:1422402006:1.source_cn: 嘶，这就是最麻烦的地方了……扎娜，你自己来说吧。

say:8:1422402007:0.text: The statue was imbued with special powers, a spell cast by the Queen herself.
say:8:1422402007:0.source_cn: 雕像被注入了特殊的力量，那是女王亲手施加的法术。
say:8:1422402007:0.male: The statue was imbued with special powers, a spell cast by the Queen herself.
say:8:1422402007:0.female: The statue was imbued with special powers, a spell cast by the Queen herself.

say:9:1422402008:0.text: This statue was once able to monitor the entirety of Sal'thorin, cause people to fall into hallucinations, and even attack blasphemers.
say:9:1422402008:0.source_cn: 这座雕像曾经能监视整个萨洛克兰，能让人陷入无边的幻觉，...
say:9:1422402008:0.male: This statue was once able to monitor the entirety of Sal'thorin, cause people to fall into hallucinations, and even attack blasphemers.
say:9:1422402008:0.female: This statue was once able to monitor the entirety of Sal'thorin, cause people to fall into hallucinations, and even attack blasphemers.

say:10:1422402009:0.text: After the Queen's death, the statue collapsed, but the broken pieces still retain magic that could get out of control at any time... It's more dangerous than you think.
say:10:1422402009:0.source_cn: 女王崩逝后雕像随即倒塌，但破碎的雕像上还残留着随时可能...
say:10:1422402009:0.male: After the Queen's death, the statue collapsed, but the broken pieces still retain magic that could get out of control at any time... It's more dangerous than you think.
say:10:1422402009:0.female: After the Queen's death, the statue collapsed, but the broken pieces still retain magic that could get out of control at any time... It's more dangerous than you think.

choice_prompt:11:1422402009.text: After the Queen's death, the statue collapsed, but the broken pieces still retain magic that could get out of control at any time... It's more dangerous than you think.
choice_prompt:11:1422402009.source_cn: 女王崩逝后雕像随机倒塌，但破碎的雕像上还残留着随时可能失控的魔法……这更加危险。
choice_prompt:11:1422402009.male: After the Queen's death, the statue collapsed, but the broken pieces still retain magic that could get out of control at any time... It's more dangerous than you think.
choice_prompt:11:1422402009.female: After the Queen's death, the statue collapsed, but the broken pieces still retain magic that could get out of control at any time... It's more dangerous than you think.

say:12:1422402010:0.text: Yes, this is the last step. In the process of restoring the statue, I found that three pieces were missing...
say:12:1422402010:0.source_cn: 这是最后一步。我在复原雕像的过程中发现缺少了三个碎块……
say:12:1422402010:0.male: Yes, this is the last step. In the process of restoring the statue, I found that three pieces were missing...
say:12:1422402010:0.female: Yes, this is the last step. In the process of restoring the statue, I found that three pieces were missing...

say:13:1422402011:0.text: We need to dispel all the magic, or it may lead to a greater disaster.
say:13:1422402011:0.source_cn: 如果不能完整地解除魔法，可能会引发更大的灾难。
say:13:1422402011:0.male: We need to dispel all the magic, or it may lead to a greater disaster.
say:13:1422402011:0.female: We need to dispel all the magic, or it may lead to a greater disaster.

say:14:1422402012:1.text: Priestess Zana has studied this kind of magic, and she's the most suitable person to handle this matter. However, she insists on guarding this spot...
say:14:1422402012:1.source_cn: 扎娜祭司研究过这种魔法，她是最适合处理这件事的人。但她...
say:14:1422402012:1.male: Priestess Zana has studied this kind of magic, and she's the most suitable person to handle this matter. However, she insists on guarding this spot...
say:14:1422402012:1.female: Priestess Zana has studied this kind of magic, and she's the most suitable person to handle this matter. However, she insists on guarding this spot...

say:15:1422402013:0.text: I have to make sure the existing pieces don't get out of control. Xera told me you, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, are one of the greatest mages of the Lightbearer Empire...
say:15:1422402013:0.source_cn: 我得保证现有的碎块不至于失控。席蕾说<style=st...
say:15:1422402013:0.male: I have to make sure the existing pieces don't get out of control. Xera told me you, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, are one of the greatest mages of the Lightbearer Empire...
say:15:1422402013:0.female: I have to make sure the existing pieces don't get out of control. Xera told me you, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, are one of the greatest mages of the Lightbearer Empire...

say:16:1422402014:0.source_cn: 拜托你了，请帮帮萨洛克兰。

choice_prompt:17:1422402014.source_cn: 拜托你了，请帮帮萨洛克兰。

say:19:1422402015:0.text: This prayer crystal can sense the lost fragments of the statue. It senses disruptive magical fluctuations... It'll help you.
say:19:1422402015:0.source_cn: 这个祭司晶石能感应到遗失的雕像碎块，那种令人不安的、冰...
say:19:1422402015:0.male: This prayer crystal can sense the lost fragments of the statue. It senses disruptive magical fluctuations... It'll help you.
say:19:1422402015:0.female: This prayer crystal can sense the lost fragments of the statue. It senses disruptive magical fluctuations... It'll help you.

say:20:1422402016:0.text: If you hold it out in front of you, you can feel the fluctuations. The closer you are to a missing piece, the stronger the fluctuations get.
say:20:1422402016:0.source_cn: 如果你把它放在身前，就能感受到那种波动。越靠近丢失的碎...
say:20:1422402016:0.male: If you hold it out in front of you, you can feel the fluctuations. The closer you are to a missing piece, the stronger the fluctuations get.
say:20:1422402016:0.female: If you hold it out in front of you, you can feel the fluctuations. The closer you are to a missing piece, the stronger the fluctuations get.

say:21:1422402017:0.text: However, be careful... This magic was meant to monitor and punish. It may make you feel uncomfortable when trying to detect it.
say:21:1422402017:0.source_cn: 但请小心……这种魔力本质上是用来监视和惩戒的。感知它的...
say:21:1422402017:0.male: However, be careful... This magic was meant to monitor and punish. It may make you feel uncomfortable when trying to detect it.
say:21:1422402017:0.female: However, be careful... This magic was meant to monitor and punish. It may make you feel uncomfortable when trying to detect it.

say:23:1422402018:0.text: Also, it seems the pieces were taken by someone... I'm worried that person might want to use the residual magic in those fragments.
say:23:1422402018:0.source_cn: 另外，碎块是被人为拿走的……我担心有人想要利用这些残留...
say:23:1422402018:0.male: Also, it seems the pieces were taken by someone... I'm worried that person might want to use the residual magic in those fragments.
say:23:1422402018:0.female: Also, it seems the pieces were taken by someone... I'm worried that person might want to use the residual magic in those fragments.

say:24:1422402019:0.text: Let me reiterate. Be careful and stay vigilant. Although the magic isn't as powerful as before, if used in certain situations, it can be very dangerous.
say:24:1422402019:0.source_cn: 务必小心。拥有这种魔力的碎块，虽然魔力已经不及从前，但...
say:24:1422402019:0.male: Let me reiterate. Be careful and stay vigilant. Although the magic isn't as powerful as before, if used in certain situations, it can be very dangerous.
say:24:1422402019:0.female: Let me reiterate. Be careful and stay vigilant. Although the magic isn't as powerful as before, if used in certain situations, it can be very dangerous.

say:25:1422402020:0.text: Understood. That means we need to find them as soon as possible.
say:25:1422402020:0.source_cn: 懂了，那就是我们得要尽快找齐它们。

choice:11:0:1.text: So, you need me to dispel the magic.
choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 所以，你们是需要我协助解除魔法？
choice:11:0:1.male: So, you need me to dispel the magic.
choice:11:0:1.female: So, you need me to dispel the magic.

say:0:1422403001:0.text: We need to find a place away from the statue here to start detecting magic.
say:0:1422403001:0.source_cn: 我们得先找个地方感知一下，得离这里的雕像远一点。
say:0:1422403001:0.male: We need to find a place away from the statue here to start detecting magic.
say:0:1422403001:0.female: We need to find a place away from the statue here to start detecting magic.

say:1:1422403002:0.text: I understand. Let's leave this area.
say:1:1422403002:0.source_cn: 我知道了，那我们走远点。
say:1:1422403002:0.male: I understand. Let's leave this area.
say:1:1422403002:0.female: I understand. Let's leave this area.

say:0:1422405001:0.text: The noble that's praying. We need to talk to him.
say:0:1422405001:0.source_cn: 在那个正在祈祷的贵族身上。
say:0:1422405001:0.male: The noble that's praying. We need to talk to him.
say:0:1422405001:0.female: The noble that's praying. We need to talk to him.

say:1:1422406001:1.text: Outsiders are not welcome here! Leave!

say:2:1422406002:1.text: By the authority of Imperator Ravion, we're here on official business. Our mission is to investigate the disappearance of the late queen's statue pieces.
say:2:1422406002:1.source_cn: 咳咳。奉沙利叶统领之名，我们来此执行公务，前来调查女王...

say:3:1422406003:1.text: Ravion? What's he the Imperator of now? He has no authority over me!
say:3:1422406003:1.source_cn: 沙利叶？哼，他现在算什么统领，还有什么权力管我？

say:4:1422406004:1.text: This is not a question of power or authority. The residual magic left in the statue is extremely dangerous. For the safety of everyone in Sal'thorin, please cooperate.
say:4:1422406004:1.source_cn: 这不是权力的问题。雕像上残留的魔法极其危险，为了萨洛克...

say:5:1422406005:1.text: I have nothing here! Where is your evidence to accuse me of such things?!
say:5:1422406005:1.source_cn: 我这里什么都没有！你们有什么证据吗？

choice_prompt:6:1422406005.text: I have nothing here! Where is your evidence to accuse me of such things?!
choice_prompt:6:1422406005.source_cn: 我这里什么都没有！你们有什么证据吗？

say:7:1422406006:1.text: My lord, the great mage here senses something... Please don't make it harder than it already is.
say:7:1422406006:1.source_cn: 阁下，我们有大魔法师在此感应……别让事情变得更麻烦，好吗？
say:7:1422406006:1.male: My lord, the great mage here senses something... Please don't make it harder than it already is.
say:7:1422406006:1.female: My lord, the great mage here senses something... Please don't make it harder than it already is.

say:9:1422406007:1.text: Such insolence! You obviously came here with a vendetta! Guards!
say:9:1422406007:1.source_cn: 可笑！明明是你们来找我麻烦！卫兵！卫兵——

say:10:1422406008:1.text: Remove these outsiders from my sight at once!
say:10:1422406008:1.source_cn: 把这些借公务之名的入侵者赶出去！

choice:6:0:1.text: I felt a disturbance in magic.
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 我感受到了特殊的魔力波动
choice:6:0:1.male: I felt a disturbance in magic.
choice:6:0:1.female: I felt a disturbance in magic.

say:1:1422407001:1.text: What an unexpected turn of events... I can't believe these people pretended to be guards.
say:1:1422407001:1.source_cn: 没想到还有意外收获，这帮人还真敢冒充卫兵。

say:2:1422407002:1.text: Once the matter of the statue is resolved, I'll have to report all this to Imperator Ravion.
say:2:1422407002:1.source_cn: 等雕像的事解决了，得像沙利叶大人报告这件事了。

say:3:1422407003:1.text: My lord, please hand over the statue pieces.
say:3:1422407003:1.source_cn: 阁下，你是不是得把碎块交出来了？

say:5:1422407004:1.text: Here, take it. It's all over now anyway.
say:5:1422407004:1.source_cn: 拿去吧……反正现在什么都完了。

choice_prompt:6:1422407004.text: Here, take it. It's all over now anyway.
choice_prompt:6:1422407004.source_cn: 拿去吧……反正现在什么都完了。

say:7:1422407005:1.text: Do you know how much Sal'thorin has changed? In the past, when we said something, everyone would tremble in fear.
say:7:1422407005:1.source_cn: ……你们知道萨洛克兰变化有多大吗？以前我们说一句话，所...

say:9:1422407006:1.text: Now? Even the lowest servants dare to look upon us with contempt!
say:9:1422407006:1.source_cn: 现在呢？连最低等的仆从都敢用轻蔑的眼神看我们！

say:10:1422407007:1.text: Our status and privileges are gone. Even our supply of Divine Dew is limited now.
say:10:1422407007:1.source_cn: 地位没了，特权没了，连灵露都要限量供应！

say:11:1422407008:1.text: Why should those commoners be treated as our equals? All of our families have been nobles for generations!
say:11:1422407008:1.source_cn: 那些平民凭什么和我们平起平坐？我们可是世代的贵族啊！

say:12:1422407009:1.text: What generations? I seem to remember that your father inherited his title from his distant relative...
say:12:1422407009:1.source_cn: 哈？世代的贵族？我倒是记得您的父亲是继承了亲戚的爵位……

say:13:1422407010:1.text: Whatever! At least the statue fragment gave me some beautiful illusions. In them, people still treated me with respect, and I could relive the days when we were powerful and revered...
say:13:1422407010:1.source_cn: 哼！总之，碎块……至少能让我看到一些美好的幻象。那些人...

say:14:1422407011:1.text: I started to rely on those illusions... Just so I can feel something...
say:14:1422407011:1.source_cn: 而我依靠它……或许能再度……

say:15:1422407012:1.text: It's funny that an illusion from a broken stone had you so enraptured.
say:15:1422407012:1.source_cn: 真是讽刺。一块破石头的幻象就能让你这么着迷？

say:16:1422407013:1.text: Open your eyes and take a good look at Sal'thorin. It's time to stop dreaming and wake up to the truth.
say:16:1422407013:1.source_cn: 睁开眼看看现在的萨洛克兰吧，我劝你早点醒悟。

say:17:1422407014:1.text: I didn't think the Queen's magic would be this potent, capable of twisting people's weaknesses so thoroughly.
say:17:1422407014:1.source_cn: 没想到女王的魔法这么厉害，连人的可怜虚荣心都能利用得这...

say:19:1422407016:1.text: Let's leave this noble lord here to reminisce about his past privileges.
say:19:1422407016:1.source_cn: 就留这位“尊贵”的贵族阁下，在这里好好回忆他那些美好的...
say:19:1422407016:1.male: Let's leave this noble lord here to reminisce about his past privileges.
say:19:1422407016:1.female: Let's leave this noble lord here to reminisce about his past privileges.

choice:6:0:1.text: What were you doing with it?
choice:6:0:1.male: What were you doing with it?
choice:6:0:1.female: What were you doing with it?

say:0:1422408001:0.text: Where should we go next, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:0:1422408001:0.male: Where should we go next, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:0:1422408001:0.female: Where should we go next, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:1:1422408002:0.text: Let's go to the commoners' district. I don't feel any fluctuations here.
say:1:1422408002:0.source_cn: 去平民区看看吧，这里没有更多的感应了。
say:1:1422408002:0.male: Let's go to the commoners' district. I don't feel any fluctuations here.
say:1:1422408002:0.female: Let's go to the commoners' district. I don't feel any fluctuations here.

say:0:1422409001:0.source_cn: 在东南方，我们去那边找找看。

say:0:1422410001:0.text: I sense a strong magical fluctuation from that lady over there.
say:0:1422410001:0.source_cn: 我在那位女士身上感受到了强烈的魔法波动。
say:0:1422410001:0.male: I sense a strong magical fluctuation from that lady over there.
say:0:1422410001:0.female: I sense a strong magical fluctuation from that lady over there.

say:1:1422411001:1.text: We're here to investigate the theft of a piece of the Queen's statue. Were you in any way involved?
say:1:1422411001:1.source_cn: 女士，我们是来调查女王雕像失窃的事情。你是否牵扯其中？

say:3:1422411003:1.text: I'm sorry. I know I shouldn't have entered the royal city. But when the ban was lifted, I knew I had to go visit.
say:3:1422411003:1.source_cn: 抱歉，我知道不该进王城的。但自从禁令解除，我就一直想来...

say:4:1422411004:1.text: The royal city was even more beautiful than I ever imagined. I may have stayed longer than I intended.
say:4:1422411004:1.source_cn: 王城比我想象的还要漂亮，我就多停留了一段时间。

choice_prompt:5:1422411004.text: The royal city was even more beautiful than I ever imagined. I may have stayed longer than I intended.
choice_prompt:5:1422411004.source_cn: 王城比我想象的还要漂亮，我就多停留了一段时间。

say:6:1422411005:1.text: Yeah... I've never met the Queen. She's like a legend to us commoners.
say:6:1422411005:1.source_cn: 是的……我从没见过女王。对我们这些平民来说，她就像传说...
say:6:1422411005:1.male: Yeah... I've never met the Queen. She's like a legend to us commoners.
say:6:1422411005:1.female: Yeah... I've never met the Queen. She's like a legend to us commoners.

say:7:1422411006:1.text: Now that she's gone, we'll never see her again. So, when I saw the pieces of her statue...
say:7:1422411006:1.source_cn: 现在她已经不在了，我们永远也见不到她了。所以当我看到碎...
say:7:1422411006:1.male: Now that she's gone, we'll never see her again. So, when I saw the pieces of her statue...
say:7:1422411006:1.female: Now that she's gone, we'll never see her again. So, when I saw the pieces of her statue...

say:8:1422411007:1.source_cn: 我就忍不住私藏了一块。

say:9:1422411008:1.text: You shouldn't have done that. That fragment is very dangerous. It contains the Queen's magic.
say:9:1422411008:1.source_cn: 事实上，那个碎块很危险，里面蕴藏了女王的特殊魔法。

say:10:1422411009:1.text: No wonder I've been having such strange dreams lately. I dreamed I was standing somewhere high, looking down at everyone below. It felt so real...
say:10:1422411009:1.source_cn: 怪不得……我最近总是做一些奇怪的梦。梦见自己站在高处，...

say:11:1422411010:1.text: But after waking up, I would feel very uneasy.
say:11:1422411010:1.source_cn: 但醒来后又觉得很不安。

choice_prompt:12:1422411010.text: But after waking up, I would feel very uneasy.
choice_prompt:12:1422411010.source_cn: 但醒来后又觉得很不安。

say:13:1422411011:1.text: I stashed it in a special place, one I used all the time as a kid. Follow me.
say:13:1422411011:1.source_cn: 我把它藏在了一个特别的地方。那里……是我小时候最喜欢的...
say:13:1422411011:1.male: I stashed it in a special place, one I used all the time as a kid. Follow me.
say:13:1422411011:1.female: I stashed it in a special place, one I used all the time as a kid. Follow me.

choice:5:0:1.text: Did you take a piece of the statue?
choice:5:0:1.source_cn: 你拿了女王雕像的碎块吗？
choice:5:0:1.male: Did you take a piece of the statue?
choice:5:0:1.female: Did you take a piece of the statue?

say:0:1422412001:0.text: Oh, the flying squirrels seem to be very interested in it.
say:0:1422412001:0.source_cn: 糟了，小飞鼠们好像对它很感兴趣。

say:1:1422412002:0.text: We may need to lure these squirrels away.
say:1:1422412002:0.source_cn: 看来，我们得把小飞鼠引开了。

say:0:1422413001:0.text: The flying squirrels have left. Let's go get the piece of the statue.
say:0:1422413001:0.source_cn: 小飞鼠离开了，大人们可以去拿雕像碎块了。

say:1:1422413002:0.text: This has been a tough job so far...
say:1:1422413002:0.source_cn: 真是一趟不容易的公务。

say:3:1422417002:0.text: Ha! Yeah, we were repairing the pavement in the royal city when their queen died.

say:3:1422417002:0.female: Ha! Yeah, we were repairing the pavement in the royal city when their queen died.

say:6:1422417004:0.female: This material... I've never seen anything this peculiar! The texture, the hardness—it's perfect.

say:6:1422419005:0.text: Apologies, before we begin, I would like to recite a eulogy for the Queen. Something I wrote personally.

say:8:1422419006:0.text: You lit up the darkness with your mortal form and wove the immortal city with your very flesh and blood. Your sacrifice will never be forgotten.
say:8:1422419006:0.source_cn: 您以凡人之躯照亮黑暗，用血肉织就不朽之城。

say:9:1422419007:0.text: Rest in peace in the name of all Essail.
say:9:1422419007:0.source_cn: 今日您当以艾塞勒之名安息。

say:10:1422419008:0.text: I am finished. Thank you for waiting.
say:10:1422419008:0.source_cn: 我说完了，诸位。感谢等待。

choice_prompt:11:1422419008.text: I am finished. Thank you for waiting.
choice_prompt:11:1422419008.source_cn: 我说完了，诸位。感谢等待。

say:12:1422419009:0.text: I was once one of Her Majesty's most devoted followers. Before the truth came out, I truly believed I'd serve her faithfully forever.

say:13:1422419010:0.text: But now I see things clearly. It's unreasonable to dismiss her real accomplishments, but it's just as foolish to idolize her without question.

say:13:1422419010:0.female: But now I see things clearly. It's unreasonable to dismiss her real accomplishments, but it's just as foolish to idolize her without question.

say:14:1422419011:0.text: She made Sal'thorin safe and prosperous for generations, but the price... it was too heavy.
say:14:1422419011:0.source_cn: 她确实让萨洛克兰繁盛了数千年，但代价……太过沉重。

say:14:1422419011:0.female: She made Sal'thorin safe and prosperous for generations, but the price... it was too heavy.

say:16:1422419013:0.text: Let her rest in peace, as a mortal. In doing so, the living can find their way forward, unburdened by the past.
say:16:1422419013:0.source_cn: 让她以一个凡人的身份安息吧。这样，活着的人才能真正前行。
